hypotheses.reasoning: search-api heap grew. After full GCs the old gen was not reclaimed (78%, then 87%). The process then hit OutOfMemoryError in productCache.put, most likely because the product cache has no size limit. The container was OOMKilled and restarted twice. Each restart left no healthy upstream, which explains the bursts of 502s at web-bff. No deploy was found in the logs.
One index-worker message failed schema validation and went to the DLQ. It was handled cleanly, so it is a red herring.

verdict.recommendedAction: Put a size or eviction limit on search-api's productCache, or raise its memory limit. Take a heap dump to confirm the leak. Run more replicas so one restart doesn't leave no healthy upstream.
